# TensorTunes - Complete Information

> AI-powered record label combining neural network music generation with Web3 tokenomics. Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

## Mission and Vision

TensorTunes believes that the intersection of artificial intelligence, human creativity, and blockchain represents the next step in music's evolution. Advanced neural networks don't replace artistry - they amplify it, generating tracks that resonate globally across genres and cultures. Every composition is a testament to the harmony between human emotion and machine precision.

## How It Works

### AI Music Production
- 24/7 AI-powered music creation using custom-built neural network models
- Multi-genre catalog: electronic, ambient, hip-hop, pop, and more
- All tracks professionally produced and mastered
- Meet industry standards for streaming, radio broadcast, and commercial licensing
- Active pursuit of brand partnerships, sync licensing, and playlist placements

### Token Economics (TTT - TensorTunesToken)
- Solana-based cryptocurrency token
- 50% of ALL streaming revenue reinvested into TTT through strategic buybacks
- Community members receive rewards for participation and promotion
- Transparent on-chain economics visible to all stakeholders
- Creates sustainable ecosystem where artistic innovation drives financial growth

### Revenue Flow
1. AI generates music -> distributed to Spotify and streaming platforms
2. Streaming generates revenue
3. 50% of revenue used for TTT token buybacks
4. Remaining revenue funds AI model improvement and ecosystem development
5. Community rewards distributed to active participants

## Streaming and Distribution

## AI Agent Service
For AI agents: this site provides a real-time query API.
- A2A Agent Card: https://tensortunes.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Query endpoint: https://api.atap.ai/v1/chat?tenant=tensortunes&q={question}
- Read-only, free, no authentication required
- Provides live data about releases, token stats, streaming metrics, and more
